description:
Stage qualifying a client, as the CRM's Qualified popup does: tags
them as a buyer, seller or tenant, puts them on that pipeline board
and takes them off the Lead board. Returns a preview, including what
it will COST (a place on the Buyer board uses a free place or one
credit), and an action_id; NOTHING changes or is charged until you
call confirm_action with that id, after the agent has said yes.

Without `board`, the type comes from what the CRM already knows (the
client's saved search, or a Vendor/Landlord tag); with neither, it
asks for their details instead of guessing. With `board`, the client
goes onto that board at its first step.

Requires a linked PropertyList account: the change is made in the agent's own name, with their CRM permissions, so an agency API key alone cannot make it.

board.description: The board to put them on. Optional.

contact_id.description: The client, from find_contacts or my_pipeline.

name: qualify_lead

action_id.description: Pass to confirm_action to make the change, or cancel_action to drop it.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601, UTC. After this the preview must be staged again.

summary.description: What confirming will do, to show the agent.

title: Qualify lead
